SubTopics: Determine the meaning of words and phrases as they are used in a text, distinguishing literal from nonliteral language.
Content: Read the passage.

:ibox:	Camille was excited about Alma's party. She and Alma had been best friends since kindergarten. Finally, Saturday arrived. At the party, the two friends hugged and squealed with excitement.
	“Camille, come try one of my cookies! I made them all by myself!” said Alma.
	“Sounds great,” replied Camille. She took a cookie and opened her mouth for a big bite. Ouch! The cookie was `ul(text(as hard as a rock))`. Even though she had trouble swallowing, Camille smiled at her best friend.
	“Delicious!” she said.
What do the words `ul(text(as hard as a rock))` help the reader understand?

B.Choice: The cookie tasted like a rock.

C.Choice: The cookie looked like a rock.

D.Choice: The cookie was difficult to bite into.

SubTopics: Describe characters in a story (e.g., their traits, motivations, or feelings) and explain how their actions contribute to the sequence of events.
Content: Read the passage.

:ibox:`bbtext([from] The Tale of Mrs. Ladybug)`
by Arthur Scott Bailey

	`(1)` Chirpy found Mrs. Ladybug in the orchard. But strange to say, she didn't seem at all interested in his news.
	 `(2)` “I dare say I have a cousin in the garden,” she told him. “Ours is a big family. I have more cousins than I could ever count. They're as plentiful as the leaves on the trees. I can't stop my work to go and see this one. If I called on all my cousins I'd never have time to help Farmer Green.”
	`(3)` Chirpy Cricket looked disappointed. He had expected Mrs. Ladybug to show great interest in what he told her. She certainly always thought that others ought to pay strict attention when she related the happenings about the farm. And she always wanted them to act surprised and pleased, too.
What causes Chirpy Cricket to be disappointed?

A.Choice: Mrs. Ladybug tells Chirpy Cricket that she comes from a big family.

B.Choice: Mrs. Ladybug is too busy to be interested in what Chirpy Cricket says.

C.Choice: Chirpy Cricket finds Mrs. Ladybug when she is working in the orchard.

D.Choice: Chirpy Cricket knows that Mrs. Ladybug wants others to pay attention to her.
